goal: Add Vitest regression tests for the RunSearchError class (tracker-api/src/services/search-runner.ts) in a new test file. Change nothing else.
acceptance_criteria: A new test file exists at tracker-api/tests/services/search-runner.test.ts, mirroring the src path (project decision-002). It mocks '../../src/lib/prisma' the same way tracker-api/tests/services/facebook-scraper.test.ts does and imports RunSearchError from '../../src/services/search-runner'.
new RunSearchError('boom') is an instance of both RunSearchError and Error, has name === 'RunSearchError' and message === 'boom'.
new RunSearchError('boom', { cause }) keeps the same cause object (asserted with toBe).
new RunSearchError('boom') without options has cause undefined.
The new file contains exactly three tests and does not call runSavedSearch.
The Orchestrator's measured changed-file list contains only tracker-api/tests/services/search-runner.test.ts, and no dependency is added.
`npm --prefix tracker-api test` passes, including all existing tests (currently 40 in 5 files).
context: RunSearchError (tracker-api/src/services/search-runner.ts lines 17-22) extends Error, passes (message, options) to super and sets this.name = 'RunSearchError'. No test covers it. search-runner.ts imports the listings and searches stores (which use Prisma) and the Facebook scraper module; tracker-api/tests/services/facebook-scraper.test.ts shows that vi.mock('../../src/lib/prisma', () => ({ prisma: {} })) is sufficient setup for importing these modules. tsconfig targets ES2022, so Error options with cause are supported. tracker-api uses Vitest 3 (`npm test` runs `vitest run`). File scope is verified by the Orchestrator from its own measurement of changed files.
